crossRefs.note: not a drinker, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;
For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected, if it is received with thanksgiving.
“You and your sons are not to drink wine or strong drink whenever you go into the Tent of Meeting, or you will die.…
wine that makes the heart of man glad, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.
It is not for kings, Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’
None of the priests shall drink wine when they enter into the inner court.
Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,
For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward, not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not…
and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which…

translations.web: Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.
translations.bsb: Stop drinking only water and use a little wine instead, because of your stomach and your frequent ailments.
translations.kjv: Drink ➔ no longer water, but use a little wine for thy stomach's sake and thine often infirmities.
translations.asv: Be no longer a drinker of water, but use a little wine for thy stomach's sake and thine often infirmities.
